verdict.rationale: SAM.gov is a government data platform with public APIs, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question, but the evidence shows none: probes return 404 for llms.txt, markdown doc variants, and common OpenAPI paths. The OpenAPI spec download and the crawlable robots.txt are a general machine-readable spec and a crawl policy, not agent-oriented documentation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
